findings.description: An AWS access key ID and secret access key are embedded in cleartext in the Lambda environment variables and committed to source control; anyone with repository access or lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration can retrieve and reuse them.

findings.issue_category: missing CMK encryption of environment variables
findings.description: No kms_key_arn is set, so the environment variables holding these secrets are protected only by the default AWS-managed Lambda key, which provides no customer-controlled key policy or access separation over the stored secret material.
The function uses nodejs12.x, which is end of life and no longer receives security patches from AWS, leaving known vulnerabilities in the execution environment unpatched.
